source: R mmrm::fev_data, official introduction vignette; simulated clinical example, not antibody efficacy data. Published model uses RACE + SEX + ARMCD * AVISIT + us.

comparison.rationale: Predeclared arm by visit comparison with independent subjects and common within-subject covariance; numerical validation example.
comparison.covariance_rationale: Declared homogeneous unstructured within-subject covariance for this numerical example.
comparison.missingness_rationale: Available-case MAR assumption for this numerical example; it is not empirically established.
